items.stem: —What are you going to be when you grow up? —I ____ a doctor.
items.explanation: be going to 表示打算，后接动词原形 be，问句也用这一结构。只写 be 缺助动词，being 是分词，was 是过去式。

items.stem: Look at the dark clouds. It ____ rain.
items.explanation: 有明显迹象预示将要发生，用 be going to。goes to 表去处，is going 缺 to do，going to 缺系动词。

items.stem: —Will you go to the party tomorrow? —No, I ____.
items.explanation: 以 Will 开头的问句用 will 或 won't 作答。don't 配一般现在时，didn't 是过去，aren't 不能回应 will。

items.stem: I think there ____ more robots in the future.
items.explanation: There will be 表示将来存在，不能用 There will have。are have 混用两种结构，is 与复数 robots 不符。

items.stem: If it ____ tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
items.explanation: 主句用将来时，if 从句用一般现在时表将来。will rain 是主句才用的形式，rained 与 raining 都不合时态搭配。

items.stem: She will call you as soon as she ____ home.
items.explanation: as soon as 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来。will get 是主句形式，got 与 getting 时态或形式不配套。

items.stem: 下面哪个词是比较级形式（　）
items.explanation: 单音节形容词加 -er 构成比较级，taller 符合要求。tall 是原级，tallest 是最高级，talls 形式不存在。

items.stem: This book is ____ than that one.
items.explanation: 多音节形容词比较级用 more 加原级，且 than 要求比较级。interesting 是原级，most 是最高级，interested 形容人的感受。

items.stem: She is the ____ student in our class.
items.explanation: 三者以上比较用最高级，且前面有 the。tall 是原级，taller 是两者比较，more tall 用法错误。

items.stem: good 的比较级和最高级分别是（　）
items.explanation: good 是不规则变化，比较级 better、最高级 best。加 -er 或加 more 的规则变化不适用于它，顺序也颠倒了。

items.stem: My bike is ____ than yours.
items.explanation: than 提示用比较级，单音节词 new 变 newer。new 是原级，newest 是最高级，more new 用法错误。

items.stem: bad 的比较级是（　）
items.explanation: bad 是不规则变化，比较级 worse、最高级 worst。加 -er 与加 more 都不适用，worst 是最高级。

items.stem: 「你最好早点睡觉」的英语是（　）
options: You should went to bed earlier.
You should to go to bed earlier.
You should going to bed earlier.
You should go to bed earlier.
items.explanation: should 是情态动词，后接动词原形。带 to、用分词或过去式都与 should 的用法不符。

items.stem: —I have a bad cold. —You ____ see a doctor.
items.explanation: should 后接动词原形，此处表示提建议。should to 多了 to，are should 混用系动词，shoulding 形式不存在。

items.stem: —Must I finish it now? —No, you ____.
items.explanation: 以 Must 提问时否定回答用 needn't，表示不必。mustn't 意为禁止，can't 表不能，shouldn't 表不该。

items.stem: You ____ play football on the road. It's dangerous.
items.explanation: 路上踢球危险，表示禁止用 mustn't。needn't 表不必，may 与 can 表许可，都与危险语境相反。

items.stem: 「为什么不和我们一起去」的英语是（　）
options: Why not to come with us?
items.explanation: Why not 后接动词原形，是提建议的固定句式。don't 后缺主语，加 to 或用 no 都不合该结构。

items.stem: How about ____ a walk after dinner?
items.explanation: How about 后接动名词，用 taking。take 是原形，to take 是不定式，took 是过去式，都不搭配。

items.stem: —How often do you exercise? —____
items.explanation: How often 问频次，答 Twice a week。Two weeks 与 For two weeks 答时长，In two weeks 答将来时段。

items.stem: cut 的过去式是（　）
items.explanation: cut 的三种形式都是 cut，属 AAA 型不规则动词。cutted 是按规则误变，cutting 是现在分词，cuts 是第三人称单数。

items.stem: He ____ in Shanghai for ten years.
items.explanation: for ten years 指已持续的时间段并与过去相关，此处用过去式 lived。lives 与 live 是现在时，living 缺助动词。

items.stem: —Where did you go last Sunday? —I ____ to the park.
items.explanation: last Sunday 是过去时间，未指明具体时段用一般过去时，答语用 went。gone 是过去分词，go 与 going 时态或形式错。

items.stem: It's important ____ English well.
items.explanation: It's + 形容词 + to do 是固定句型，用不定式 to learn。learn 是原形，learning 不作此句真正主语，learned 是过去式。

items.stem: He decided ____ a new bike.
items.explanation: decide 后接不定式 to do，故用 to buy。buy 是原形，buying 不作 decide 的宾语，bought 是过去式。

items.stem: —Could you please ____ the window? —Sure.
items.explanation: Aould you please 后接动词原形，表示委婉请求。加 to、用分词或过去式都不符合这一句式。

items.stem: 「请你不要在这里吸烟好吗」的英语是（　）
options: Would you mind not smoking here?
Would you mind not to smoke here?
Would you mind don't smoke here?
Would you mind no smoking here?
items.explanation: mind 后接动名词，否定把 not 放前面，故为 not smoking。to smoke、don't smoke、no smoking 都不合。

items.stem: I'm sorry ____ you waiting so long.
items.explanation: be sorry to do 表示因做某事而抱歉，用 to keep。keep 是原形，keeping 不作此结构，kept 是过去式。

items.stem: He is ____ young ____ go to school.
items.explanation: too…to 表示太……而不能，此处即年龄太小不能上学。so…that 后接从句，enough 语序相反，very…to 不合结构。

items.stem: The box is ____ heavy for me ____ carry.
items.explanation: too 加形容词加 to do 表示太……以致不能。其余三项的搭配顺序或连词都不合这一固定结构。

items.stem: 「他昨天花了两个小时做作业」的英语是（　）
options: He took two hours do his homework yesterday.
It took him two hours to do his homework yesterday.
It spent him two hours doing his homework yesterday.
He cost two hours to do his homework yesterday.
items.explanation: It takes sb. some time to do sth. 是固定句型，只有第一句结构完整。其余三句动词或宾语搭配都错。

items.stem: —What's the matter with you? —____
items.explanation: What's the matter 问身体不适，答 I have a cold 最贴合。另三句分别回应问候、歉意与道歉，都不对症。

items.stem: You should ____ some medicine and drink more water.
items.explanation: should 后接动词原形 take。takes 是第三人称单数，taking 是分词，took 是过去式，都不合情态动词用法。

items.stem: We ____ go to the museum if it ____ fine tomorrow.
items.explanation: 主句用一般将来时 will go，if 从句用一般现在时 is。其余各项时态错配，主从句不能都用将来时。

items.stem: She ____ go to bed until her mother came back.
items.explanation: not…until 表示直到……才，从句用过去式，主句也用过去时 didn't。现在时与将来时与 came 的时态不匹配。

items.stem: 下面哪个词与 friendly 构成同义表达（　）
items.explanation: friendly 表友好，与 kind 意思相近。angry 是生气，lazy 是懒惰，strict 是严格，感情色彩都不对应。

items.stem: He is one of the ____ students in our school.
items.explanation: one of the 加形容词最高级加复数名词，故用 best。better 用于两者比较，good 是原级，well 是副词。

items.stem: —Who is ____, Tom or Jack? —Tom is.
items.explanation: 两者比较用比较级 taller，不加 the。tallest 与 the tallest 用于三者以上比较，tall 是原级。

items.stem: The more you read, ____ you will be.
items.explanation: the 加比较级、the 加比较级的对照结构，故为 the cleverer。缺 the 或误用原级都不合该句式。

items.stem: 「我们应该学着照顾自己」的英语是（　）
options: We should learning to look after ourselves.
We should learn to look after us.
We should to learn look after ourselves.
We should learn to look after ourselves.
items.explanation: should 后接原形 learn，learn 后接不定式，反身代词用 ourselves。加 to、用分词或误用宾格 us 都不合。

items.stem: If you don't know the word, you can ____ in a dictionary.
items.explanation: 代词作宾语须放在 look 与 up 之间，故为 look it up。look up it 语序错，look after 意为照顾，语义不合。
